body.name: The Ember Road
body.description: Lamplighters are vanishing along the road to Hollowmere, and the fog that follows them smells of cinders.

body.title: The Toll at Cinder Bridge
body.description: The company meets, and pays a toll nobody should have asked for.
body.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"es1a","kind":"heading","text":"Recap","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"es1b","kind":"paragraph","text":"Reeve Halda Morrow hired the company at the Drowned Lantern. On the road north, bandits in ash-grey cloaks held Cinder Bridge and demanded a toll in lamp oil.","options":{}},{"id":"es1c","kind":"bullet","text":"Wren picked the toll-keeper's pocket and found a map of every lamp post in Hollowmere.","options":{}},{"id":"es1d","kind":"bullet","text":"The bandits fled into the fog rather than fight.","options":{}}]}

body.title: Smoke over Hollowmere
body.description: The fog reaches the town, and one more lamp goes dark.
body.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"es2a","kind":"heading","text":"Recap","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"es2b","kind":"paragraph","text":"Old Tamsin, the last lamplighter, swore she saw a figure with a burning hand walk out of the fog. By morning her lamp was cold and she was gone.","options":{}},{"id":"es2c","kind":"todo","text":"Follow the soot trail east of the bridge","options":{"done":false}}]}

body.title: The Missing Lamplighters
body.description: Five lamplighters have vanished from Hollowmere in a month, and nobody knows what took them.
body.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"eq2a","kind":"paragraph","text":"Every disappearance happened on a night the fog came in from the east.","options":{}},{"id":"eq2b","kind":"callout","text":"Reward: 200 gp and free lodging at the Drowned Lantern.","options":{}}]}

body.title: Reeve Halda Morrow
body.description: Hollowmere's tired reeve, who pays in coin she does not quite have.

body.title: The Ashen Hand
body.description: The cult leader behind the fog. Kept from the players until they earn the name.
body.body: {"blocks":[{"id":"ena1","kind":"heading","text":"DM only","options":{"level":2}},{"id":"ena2","kind":"paragraph","text":"Feeds the stolen lamplight to an ember spirit bound beneath Cinder Bridge. Wants Hollowmere dark by midwinter.","options":{}}]}

body.title: Old Tamsin
body.description: Hollowmere's last lamplighter, who swore she saw a burning hand in the fog the night before she vanished.

body.title: Hollowmere
body.description: A lakeside town of crooked roofs and a hundred lamp posts, fewer lit each week.

body.title: The Drowned Lantern
body.description: Hollowmere's inn, half sunk into the lake shore. The ale is warm and the gossip is warmer.

body.title: Lantern of Kindled Paths
body.description: While lit, it shows footprints left in the last day as faint embers.

body.body: Welcome back to the Ember Road. The fog over Cinder Bridge is thicker tonight.
Wren slips under the bridge and waits for the captain to turn his back.
